name: godot
description: Godot 4's words (#433): MeshInstance3D with a BoxMesh, OmniLight3D and SpotLight3D in physical units, each with its stated conversion. A word with no mapping is refused.

MeshInstance3D.conversion: BoxMesh to slab@1; rotation YXZ radians through the matrix to ours

SpotLight3D.conversion: light_intensity_lumens kept (Godot's spot counts the whole sphere, as ours); spot_angle the outer half angle
